accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the start-up infrastructure of Andhra Pradesh during FY 2024-25:
1. The State had 50 incubators.
2. It was ranked seventh largest in start-up infrastructure.
3. The State had 25,000 start-up-related jobs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh had 50 incubators and was described as having the seventh-largest start-up infrastructure. The figure of 25,000 refers to jobs, but it is not stated as a measure of start-up infrastructure ranking; therefore, statements 1 and 2 are correct in this formulation.
accepted.tq: Split infrastructure facts from employment facts before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: AP start-up and innovation policy - AP Innovation Society, Ratan Tata Innovation Hub

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the broader significance of Indian start-ups:
1. Start-ups have created more than 20 lakh jobs since 2016.
2. Approximately 48 percent of start-ups have a woman director.
3. Approximately 53 percent of start-ups originate from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: start-ups created more than 20 lakh jobs since 2016, about 48 percent have a woman director, and 53 percent are from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.
accepted.tq: Verify each percentage and time reference independently before choosing the combined code.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the comparative coverage of Stand-Up India and MUDRA:
1. Stand-Up India targets SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
2. Stand-Up India provides loans ranging from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore.
3. MUDRA covers micro units up to ₹20 lakh under Tarun Plus.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Stand-Up India targets SC/ST and women entrepreneurs and provides loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore. MUDRA covers micro units up to ₹20 lakh under Tarun Plus.
accepted.tq: Compare target groups and loan ranges without interchanging the two schemes.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly distinguishes Stand-Up India from MUDRA in terms of loan coverage?
o: Stand-Up India: up to ₹20 lakh; MUDRA: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore
Stand-Up India: ₹20 lakh to ₹1 crore; MUDRA: up to ₹5 lakh
Stand-Up India: up to ₹10 lakh; MUDRA: above ₹1 crore
Stand-Up India: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore; MUDRA: up to ₹20 lakh under Tarun Plus
accepted.x: Stand-Up India covers loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore, while MUDRA covers micro units up to ₹20 lakh under Tarun Plus.
accepted.tq: Split the options by scheme and verify both loan ranges together.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
